B2.title: Homebuyers Win Against Developers
B2.body: The Bombay High Court has made a significant decision that benefits homebuyers in India. It has dismissed a challenge by a developer regarding the use of additional Floor Space Index (FSI) to delay conveyance to housing societies. Conveyance refers to the process of transferring ownership of a property from the developer to the housing society. In the past, some developers have used the promise of additional FSI as a reason to delay this process. However, the court has now ruled that this practice is not acceptable. The decision is a big win for homebuyers who have been waiting for years to take ownership of their properties. The court's ruling means that developers can no longer use the possibility of additional FSI as an excuse to delay the conveyance process.
